standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback square
standard_prerequisites.statement: A commutative square is a pullback when the induced map from the domain into the pullback of the cospan is an equivalence.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the conclusion of the theorem, in the sense of the retained exercise.

standard_prerequisites.name: Pointed types
standard_prerequisites.statement: pointed type is the type of pairs (X, x) with x : X, and proj1 is the forgetful map to type.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the codomain of the map vartheta_f whose square is analysed.

standard_prerequisites.name: Univalence
standard_prerequisites.statement: An equivalence of types gives a path between them, so an equivalence between A and a pullback gives the required identification.
standard_prerequisites.use: It underlies the chain of equivalences exhibited in the proof.

core_obligations: Exhibit the composite equivalence A ~ B x_type pointed type as a five-step chain: A is the total space of the fibers of f, which is the total space of pairs (b,X,p) with p : hfiber f b = X and a point of X, and then repackaged as pairs (b,Y) with Y pointed and hfiber f b = proj1 Y (source lines 876-884).
Display the action of this composite equivalence on a point a step by step, following where a and refl sit at each rearrangement (source lines 885-891).

Read off from that display the two homotopies f ~ proj1 o e and vartheta_f ~ proj2 o e, which say exactly that the square commutes and that the comparison map is the given one, hence that it is an equivalence (source line 892).

proof_roadmap.step: Build the composite equivalence by a five-step chain.
Track the action on points to identify the two components.
Read off the two homotopies and conclude the pullback property.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Theorem 4.8.4 at source lines 859-874: for any f : A -> B the square comparing f with the projection of the pointed types, along the map vartheta_f, is a pullback. The author's proof (source lines 875-893) is not a diagram-chasing citation: it constructs a composite equivalence A ~ B x_type pointed type through a five-step chain in which the fiber decomposition of A, the introduction of an equality between the fiber and a type, and the repackaging into pointed types are performed one after another (lines 876-884), and then it has to identify the two components of that equivalence with f and vartheta_f, which is done by tracking the action of the composite on a point step by step (lines 885-891) before reading off the two homotopies (line 892). The statement exhibits only the square and the formula for vartheta_f.
